title: ReleaseSetManifest
description: The dashboard-owned complete release-set member manifest. Each target manifest binds one member of an exact four-target cohort to the dashboard and updater binaries, third-party license evidence, a software bill of materials, and the digest of every immutable installed file. Where the composed tree carries the bundled A2A runtime, a2a_component additionally binds the pinned A2A source build, the trusted dashboard-owned component lock, and the placed runtime subtree; where it does not, a2a_component is omitted outright, because an empty object or a zeroed file_count would read as a runtime the tree failed to carry rather than one it never claimed. A candidate manifest never authorizes its own component lock: consumers compare the declared component-lock digest with independently trusted lock bytes and verify all four cohort members together. The cohort digest is intentionally external to every member manifest so hashing the four raw member documents is non-circular.
x-vaultspec-invariants: Cohort aggregation emits a separate descriptor validated by $defs/CohortDescriptor only after the raw-byte SHA-256 digest of each of the four member manifests exists.

The cohort-digest preimage is exactly the RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme serialization of the validated CohortDescriptor, encoded as UTF-8 with no byte-order mark and no trailing bytes. SHA-256 of exactly those bytes is the cohort digest.

CohortDescriptor.members maps each TargetTriple to its member-manifest raw-byte SHA-256 digest in canonical TargetTriple enum order. The descriptor's own JCS-byte digest is bound by candidate authority and the active receipt and is never embedded back into a member manifest.
Every member cohort.id must equal the validated external CohortDescriptor.id; Cohort aggregation enforces this across publication inputs, and candidate verification enforces it for a candidate.

file_digests covers every immutable installed regular file except exactly release_manifest.path. Candidate verification rejects release_manifest.path in file_digests, permits no other exclusion, and requires the manifest raw bytes to match the independently supplied member digest from cohort or candidate authority and later the receipt.
The component_lock digest is only a join claim. Candidate bytes cannot authorize their own lock; candidate verification compares it with independently trusted component-lock bytes.

a2a_component is present exactly when the composed tree carries the bundled A2A runtime, and is omitted entirely otherwise. Present, it is whole: component_lock and runtime are both required and runtime.file_count has a floor of 1, so a bundled runtime is not expressible as empty. Omission is therefore the only encoding of absence, and a consumer that needs a runtime refuses the member rather than reading a fabricated entrypoint out of a stub.

Omitting a2a_component does not advance schema_version past 2.0. No field changed shape and no field was removed from the object, so every 2.0 document that carried a2a_component still validates unchanged; the change is that the top-level required list no longer demands one. A version bump would claim a breaking replacement that did not happen.

schema_version.description: The first complete release-set member contract. This is a breaking replacement for the incomplete draft shape.

cohort.description: The immutable member-visible identity shared by all four target manifests. Consumers verify four manifests with one common id and the closed target roster below. After all four raw member digests exist, cohort aggregation emits the external $defs/CohortDescriptor; every member cohort.id must equal descriptor.id. SHA-256 of the descriptor's RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 bytes is the receipt-bound cohort digest and is never embedded in a member.

targets.description: The complete cohort roster in canonical TargetTriple enum order.

release_manifest.description: Identity of this member manifest in the installed tree. Its bytes cannot digest themselves: this is the sole file excluded from file_digests and is instead bound by the independently supplied member-manifest raw-byte digest in the external cohort or candidate authority and later the active receipt.

dashboard.description: The principal dashboard executable installed by this target release set.

updater.description: The product-owned external updater copied for transactional activation and rollback.

a2a_component.description: The pinned A2A source build plus independently verifiable evidence for its component lock and for the bundled runtime placed in this tree.

component_lock.description: Identity of the dashboard-owned component lock. The digest is a join claim only; authorization comes from independently trusted lock bytes supplied by the installed product or release verifier.

runtime.description: The frozen PyInstaller onedir the release pipeline built from the pinned source and placed beside the dashboard executable. Its files are ordinary admitted release files, so file_digests already binds every byte; this block declares which subtree is the runtime, which file in it launches, and how many files were placed, so a truncated or empty onedir cannot pass as a smaller tree that still verifies.

root.description: App-tree-relative directory the onedir was placed under.

entrypoint.description: App-tree-relative path of the launchable frozen binary; must name a file inside root.

file_count.description: Number of regular files placed under root.

licenses.description: Installed license evidence for every bound component. Each evidence path and digest must join to file_digests during complete verification.

sbom.description: The complete software bill of materials installed with this release set. Its path and digest must join to file_digests during complete verification.

file_digests.description: Required complete digest inventory of every immutable installed regular file except exactly release_manifest.path, keyed by canonical product-root-relative path. Complete verification rejects release_manifest.path in this table, permits no other exclusion, requires every referenced artifact to join its entry, and additionally rejects case-folded path collisions and Windows reserved names.

TargetTriple.description: The four accepted desktop release targets, as Rust-style triples.

TargetRoster.description: Every supported target exactly once in the order used by the canonical external cohort descriptor.

DigestAlgorithm.description: The algorithm governing every digest in this manifest.

GitCommit.description: A full 40-hex git commit SHA, never a branch, tag, or floating ref.

ExactVersion.description: An exact numeric version with no range operator, wildcard, or latest selector.

PortableRelativePath.description: An ASCII product-root-relative path using forward slashes, at most 32 segments, with each segment at most 128 ASCII characters/bytes. It cannot be rooted, carry a drive prefix or backslash, contain empty/dot segments, or end a segment with a dot. Complete verification also rejects case-fold and platform-reserved collisions.

PositiveByteCount.description: A positive exact byte count bounded to the maximum expanded release-set evidence size.
